list.name: symbol
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM trade_aggregates ORDER BY symbol

list.name: model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model_name FROM forecasts ORDER BY model_name

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, vwap AS actual FROM trade_aggregates WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY 1
SELECT forecast_for AS time, model_name, yhat AS yhat, yhat_lower, yhat_upper FROM forecasts WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND model_name IN ($model) AND $__timeFilter(forecast_for) ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.forecast_for AS time, f.model_name, AVG(ABS(f.yhat - a.vwap)) OVER (PARTITION BY f.model_name ORDER BY f.forecast_for ROWS BETWEEN 59 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS mae FROM forecasts f JOIN trade_aggregates a ON a.symbol = f.symbol AND a.window_start = f.forecast_for WHERE f.symbol = '$symbol' AND f.model_name IN ($model) AND $__timeFilter(f.forecast_for) ORDER BY 1
SELECT model_name AS metric, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(generated_at))) AS value FROM forecasts WHERE symbol = '$symbol' GROUP BY model_name
SELECT window_start, detector_name, score FROM anomaly_scores WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND is_anomaly = TRUE AND window_start > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY window_start DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT model_name, model_version, trained_at, metrics ->> 'cv_mae' AS cv_mae, metrics ->> 'cv_rmse' AS cv_rmse FROM model_registry ORDER BY trained_at DESC LIMIT 25
